title: RobotX PhD Fellowship 2027
about: Fully funded doctoral fellowship at ETH Zurich through RobotX: one application is considered by up to three chosen RobotX groups. Start date by agreement in 2027; application deadline 27 November 2026; decisions by February 15.
requirements: Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science field, completed by August 2027
Choose up to three RobotX professors to review the application
Applications only through the online portal; email and postal applications are not considered

upskill.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems II
why: "field: Robotics" → "Foundation models for robotics: RT-2, PaLM-E - language-conditioned robot policies"
"Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science field" → "Sim-to-real transfer: training in simulation, deploying in the physical world"
